settings.title: Planting seeds
settings.description: About ten years ago, Rachel stepped in and made The Green Room her own and we’ve been growing (literally and figuratively) ever since. What started as a small local studio has bloomed into a space full of creativity, colour, and really good energy.

settings.title: Our Philosophy in Petals
settings.description: We’re big believers in creating beautiful things without compromising the place we call home. That means a foam-free approach, working with the seasons, and letting our alpine surroundings lead the way. Thoughtful, a little wild, and always made with care.

settings.title: Love Stories in Bloom
settings.description: We’ve had the absolute joy of working with the dreamiest couples, from right here at home to those travelling from all corners of the world. Every wedding is different, every story is personal, and we’re just lucky to play a small (but very floral) part in it all.

settings.title: visit us today!
settings.description: Come find us at our Three Parks shop: where the flowers are fresh, the playlists are good, and the faces are friendly. Pop in for a wander, a chat, or to start dreaming up your perfect bouquet with us.
